description: Executable AppGraphValidator conformance for UI Graph Policy Theme widget semantic checks.

diagnostics.message: More than one admitted token-category contribution claims prefix 'x-agency'.
Token category contribution 'x-agency-token-category' has invalid categoryShape evidence.
Theme widget contribution is not admitted.

cases.description: A Theme assignment widgetRef is valid when completed ModuleResolver evidence resolves the widget to the referenced module.
A Theme assignment using a custom x-* token category is valid when ModuleResolver supplies admitted token-category evidence.
A Theme assignment using an accepted custom x-* token category fails when ModuleResolver lacks admitted category evidence.
A Theme assignment using an accepted custom x-* token category fails when ModuleResolver reports conflicting category evidence.
A Theme assignment using an accepted custom x-* token category fails when ModuleResolver reports shape-mismatched category evidence.
A Theme assignment using a non-platform, non-x-* prefix fails graph-visible token-slot compatibility even if the Theme token exists.
A Theme token assignment fails closed when no loaded Theme evidence is supplied.
A Theme token assignment fails closed when more than one loaded Theme handle is supplied.
A Theme token assignment fails when the loaded Theme tokens map lacks the raw token key.
A Theme token assignment fails when the resolved token key does not match the widget slot's accepted category prefixes.
A Theme assignment fails when the resolved module widget contribution does not declare the assigned token slot.
A Theme assignment fails when the resolved module widget contribution has no graph-visible token-slot evidence.
A Theme assignment widgetRef fails when completed ModuleResolver evidence has no matching widget contribution.
A Theme assignment widgetRef fails when the matching widget contribution is not admitted.
Theme widgetRef checks do not run when ModuleResolver evidence is present but not completed.
Theme widgetRef checks do not run when no ModuleResolver evidence is supplied.
Theme widgetRef checks do not run when ModuleResolver evidence is skipped.
Theme widgetRef checks do not run when the policy does not target the loaded Surface.
A resolved widget contribution fails when it is owned by a different module than the policy widgetRef moduleId.
A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "proof".

A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "ceremony": the signer's preimage is the thing signed, so the rendering is the evidence rather than a view of it.
A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "verification": credibility depends on the surface being neither the issuer's nor the tenant's voice.

A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "attestation": the publisher is accountable for the rendered claim, so a tenant restyle transfers reliance to the wrong party.

A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "authentication": the chrome is the anti-phishing control, so a restylable credential-capture page is a phishing surface.

A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound on a route with routeClass "operation". This is the flip the closure test forced: `operation` is the residual value, and a residual value on the permissive side of the only rule keyed on the vocabulary is fail-open.
The same Theme token assignment is admitted when its widget is bound only on a route with routeClass "intake": after the correction, `intake` is the only admitting value in the vocabulary.
The same Theme token assignment is admitted on an unclassified route: absence of routeClass states nothing, so no class-keyed rule fires.
A widget bound on both an intake route and a proof route makes the assignment invalid: assignments are widget-scoped, so the refusal over-approximates in the safe direction.
A Theme token assignment is refused when its widget is bound only on a route the proof route renders through an embed-route slot; the cyclic back-embed terminates.
